literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4671/428真实纯火4649对手为非天敌固定附伤0，与混沌圣灵天敌区分',()=>{const a=structuredClone(source),b=structuredClone(require('../research/4649-reviewed-snapshot.json'));for(const x of[a,b]){x.souls=[];x.effects=[];for(const m of x.moves){m.effectIds=[];m.effectInstances=[];m.description='';m.deferredEffects=[];m.limitations=[];}}const base={maxHp:9000,atk:300,spa:300,def:300,spd:300,spe:500},s=E.createBattle({wikiSnapshots:[a,b],wikiLoadouts:[[32652,21329,10047,28421,37528],[10086,20001,10007,28741,37382]],criticals:false,builds:[{overrides:base},{overrides:{...base,spe:100}}]});const raw=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===32652),out=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(raw.effectInstances,source.effects,raw);assert.equal(out.issue,'');s.moveDefinitions[key(32652)].operations=out.operations;timed(s.fighters[0],'攻击必中');let affinity;turn(s,32652,20001,{beforeEffect(p,c){if(p==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0)affinity=c.typeAffinity(c.t.type,c.a.type);}});assert.ok(affinity<=1);assert.equal(dmg(s,'fixed'),0);assert.ok(dmg(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(32652)],raw.pp-1);})
